name: Vinod Adani
forbes_bio: Vinod Adani is the older brother of Gautam Adani, who was at one point, the world's third-richest person.
The Adani group, which started out in commodities trading, has interests in ports, airports, power generation and transmission, green energy, among others.
Vinod Adani, who lives overseas, has stakes in various group companies that are held through multiple overseas investment firms that belong to him.
The Adani group became India's second-largest cement producer in 2022, after Swiss firm Holcim's Indian assets were acquired for $10.5 billion through Vinod's investment firms.
In January 2023, U.S. firm Hindenburg Research accused the group of financial fraud and stock market manipulation, which caused its shares to plummet. The Adani group has denied any wrongdoing.

name: Antonio Gracias
sec_insider_companies: SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP (SPCX) - Director; BITGO HOLDINGS, INC. (BTGO) - TenPercentOwner; Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. (HRMY) - Director,TenPercentOwner
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Antonio Gracias is the founder and CEO of Chicago-based growth equity firm Valor Equity Partners, which has $16 billion in gross assets.
In 1995, Gracias was in law school at the University of Chicago when he founded Valor's predecessor, MG Capital.
A major Musk loyalist, Gracias met Musk through a mutual friend around 2000; Valor became one of Tesla's first institutional investors in 2005.
Much of Gracias' wealth comes from his shares of Tesla, where he served as a director from 2007 to 2021.
He's known for operationally-involved investing, even sleeping on Tesla's factory floor to work through manufacturing and supply chain issues.
forbes_facts: Gracias' first investment was $300 worth of Apple stock that his mother helped him buy when he was in middle school; He still holds it today.
Gracias and Musk have gone on family vacations and ski trips together.

name: Finn Rausing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2013-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2019)
forbes_bio: Finn Rausing sits on the board of packaging company Tetra Lavel with his siblings Kirsten and J?rn.
Finn's grandfather founded Tetra Pak, which invented aseptic ?packaging technology.
The new packaging made it possible to store beverages like milk and orange juice in cartons instead of glass bottles
His late father, Gad, bought out Finn's uncle Hans in 1995 for an estimated $7 billion.
With his siblings, Rausing also owns a stake in International Flavors & Fragrances.
forbes_facts: * Finn is reportedly a financial backer of the Formula One team Alfa Romeo F1 Team Orlen.
An attempted kidnapping of brother J?rn near his home in Sweden was foiled in 1989.

name: Lin Bin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2019-2026); Hurun China (2016-2026); Wikidata (2025)
forbes_bio: Lin Bin is vice chairman of Xiaomi, one of the world's most well-known smartphone brands.
Lin cofounded the company in 2010 and was president until 2019. Early on he oversaw recruiting, legal, finance, strategic partnerships and overseas expansion.
Prior to Xiaomi, he worked at ADP, a U.S. provider of online human resources management services, Microsoft and Google.
Lin, whose daughters went to college at Tufts University, is a member of the board of advisors at Tufts' school of engineering.
Xiaomi entered the EV market in 2024 with its SU7 sedan and has since gained popularity primarily in China.
forbes_facts: Lin and his wife Daisy donated 80,000 face masks and 10,000 pairs of goggles to Tufts Medical Center in 2020.
Lin acquired in 2026 a 1% stake in the Miami Dolphins football team's holding company at a valuation of $12.5 billion - marking a record for a minority transaction.

name: George Soros
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2021)
forbes_bio: George Soros is a hedge fund tycoon who managed client money in New York from 1969 to 2011.
In 1992, Soros shorted the British pound and reportedly made a profit of $1 billion. He became known as the man who broke the Bank of England.
Soros shifted $18 billion from his family office to his Open Society Foundations as of 2018.
Soros was born in Hungary; at 17 he left the country and put himself through the London School of Economics working as a railway porter and waiter.
Long one of the Democratic Party's biggest donors, he has given more than $200 million to candidates and PACs over the past decade.
forbes_facts: Soros' father was a lawyer. During the Nazi occupation he bought his family forged papers and bribed an official who then claimed Soros was his Christian godson.

name: Max Van Hoegaerden Herrmann Telles
forbes_bio: Max Van Hoegaerden Herrmann Telles is the son of Marcel Hermann Telles, a founding partner in Brazilian investing firm 3G Capital.
3G is best known for its investments in Anheuser-Busch InBev and Restaurant Brands International, parent of Burger King and Canadian coffee chain Tim Hortons.
Telles inherited shares in ABinBev through an inter vivos donation in 2024. His brother, Christian, also received an inheritance, but is not a billionaire.
Their father and his spouse, Bianka van Hoegaerden, divorced in 2009.
The brothers have been shareholders of São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações since 2017.

name: Stefan Reimann-Andersen
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Stefan Reimann-Andersen and three of his siblings own 95% of Luxembourg-based investment firm JAB Holding Company s.? r.l (JAB).
Upon the death of their father in 1984, Stefan and eight other heirs each inherited 11.1% of JAB; five of them subsequently divested their stakes.
The brands associated with the Reimann fortune include Pret A Manger, Krispy Kreme donuts, Peet's Coffee and Panera Bread.
Stefan is a descendant of chemist Ludwig Reimann, who, in 1828, joined with Johann Adam Benckiser and his namesake chemical company.
JAB made its first foray into the pet care sector in 2019 with the acquisition of Compassion-First Pet Hospitals.
forbes_facts: In 2016, the Reimanns commissioned a study which revealed close ties between their family, its business and the Nazi regime during World War II.
Following this discovery, the family formed the Alfred Landecker Foundation to support Holocaust survivors, conduct research and combat antisemitism.

name: Koon Poh Keong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: When Koon Poh Keong returned home to Malaysia from the U.S. after graduation, he found no jobs on offer and Malaysia was in a recession.
Poh Keong started his company by rallying his four brothers, who pooled $50,000 and began an aluminum-extruding outfit.
Poh Keong is group CEO of aluminum company Press Metal while his brother Poh Ming is the executive vice chairman.
He founded the company with his brothers by renting a factory in Puchong, Selangor, a state on the west coast of Peninsular Malaysia.
Press Metal is Southeast Asia's largest integrated aluminum producer. It competes with the likes of Rio Tinto and China's Aluminum Corp.

name: Joy Alukkas
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2013-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026); Hurun India (2015-2022)
forbes_bio: Son of a jewelry store owner and school dropout, Joy Alukkas went to the Middle East to open the family's first overseas store in 1987 in Abu Dhabi.
He broke off to launch his own jewellery chain, which now has 100 outlets spread across India and 60 overseas.
His other interests include a money exchange outfit, malls and real estate.
Alukkas' son John Paul is managing director of the international jewelry business.
Alukkas decided to postpone the public listing of the jewelry business in 2023 citing a tepid IPO market.
forbes_facts: In 1956, Alukkas' father, Varghese Alukkas, opened the first jewellery store in the family's home town of Thrissur.
Joyalukkas uses Bollywood stars as brand ambassadors.
Joy Alukkas's wife Jolly Joy heads the Joyalukkas Foundation.
Joy Alukkas' autobiography, "Spreading Joy," was released in 2023.

name: Masahiro Miki
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2008-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Masahiro Miki owns a majority stake in discount shoe store chain ABC-Mart.
ABC-Mart owns U.S. shoe brand Danner, which was added to its portfolio when it acquired LaCrosse Footwear in 2012.
A former amateur boxer, Miki founded what was the precursor to ABC-Mart in 1985 in Tokyo, importing shoes and apparel.
He stepped down as chairman of the publicly traded company in 2007.
